features.title: Company portfolio
features.scope: Group projects into products and programs; show owners, dependencies, milestones and delivery health without turning every user into an administrator.
features.executionBoundary: Groups real workspace projects into owned products. Health and milestone values are entered by the team, not inferred from surveillance.

features.title: Reusable company workspace blueprints
features.scope: Versioned bundles of approved design systems, workflows, agent teams, model policies and connection requirements; preview dependencies and instantiate an independent project with approved local overrides.
features.executionBoundary: Approved blueprint records can seed independent projects; saved connection references do not grant account access.

features.title: Sprint and Kanban delivery
features.scope: Epics, stories, tasks, bugs, backlog, sprint goals, capacity, estimates, owners, dependencies, blockers and retrospectives. AI proposes work; people approve scope and responsibility.
features.executionBoundary: Work is stored in the shared workspace. Drag or move cards between states; an assigned owner remains accountable for decisions.

features.title: Collaborative brainstorming and decisions
features.scope: Shared idea board, alternatives, clustering, comments, voting, decision rationale and conversion to an opportunity/prototype/task.
features.executionBoundary: Ideas and votes provide context for a decision. Converting an idea creates an explicit linked delivery task.

features.title: Strategic roadmap and trade-off planning
features.scope: Goals to initiatives/milestones, alternatives, capacity/dependencies, forecast assumptions and change impact across teams.
features.executionBoundary: Roadmap dates are forecasts with assumptions; changes are reviewed alongside delivery dependencies.

features.title: Bot-team workroom
features.scope: Persistent conversation with a lead bot and specialist activity feed; assign a goal, inspect delegation, intervene, cancel work and review evidence-backed deliverables.
features.executionBoundary: Live conversation can use OpenRouter. Specialist execution and external tools remain explicitly simulated unless a runtime is connected.

features.title: Bot-team operations
features.scope: Reusable team blueprints, ownership transfer, run budgets, tool health, version pinning and team evaluations; connect bot work directly to sprint tasks and approvals.
features.executionBoundary: Schedule and ownership-transfer plans are recorded; no unattended background process runs from a prototype setting.

features.title: Dynamic specialist creation and delegated execution
features.scope: A lead or execution agent can propose or create temporary specialists from approved templates at runtime, within tool/data/budget/concurrency/depth limits; preserve lineage, results and lifecycle cleanup.
features.executionBoundary: Temporary specialists require bounded scope and approval. A saved proposal does not spawn autonomous provider agents.

features.title: Architect through ChatGPT
features.scope: Expose selected Architect project tools through an authenticated ChatGPT integration: inspect status, draft requirements, request builds and open the exact result in Architect. Enforce the same permissions and review policies.
features.executionBoundary: Exports a connection manifest and permission design. It does not register a live ChatGPT app or expose private project data.

features.title: Existing-work system synchronization
features.scope: Connect issue trackers, docs and team chat with explicit ownership of each record, external IDs, conflict rules and sync status; avoid creating competing sources of truth.
features.executionBoundary: Records ownership and conflict resolution. Connector grants, remote changes and notifications require a live adapter and explicit authorization.

features.title: Supervised remediation
features.scope: An operations bot diagnoses a fault, proposes a patch or rollback, runs checks and requests the required action approval; record retries and prevent duplicate external side effects.
features.executionBoundary: Keeps evidence, retries and approvals visible. This prototype cannot automatically patch production or repeat external side effects.

features.title: Cloud cost allocation and efficiency recommendations
features.scope: Join connected cloud billing and utilization data; allocate EC2/S3 and other supported service costs to projects/teams/environments; surface evidence-backed efficiency opportunities and reviewed implementation tasks.
features.executionBoundary: Cost figures are user-entered or sample data. Recommendations need billing/utilization evidence and review before infrastructure changes.

features.title: Accounts and relationship records
features.scope: Shared accounts, contacts, ownership, relationship history and stable identities. Customer-success views reuse these records.
features.executionBoundary: Account identity is reused across opportunities, customer feedback and renewals; creating a record does not send outreach.

features.title: Lead capture, qualification and routing
features.scope: Capture/import, deduplicate, qualify, assign and retain source/contact preferences.
features.executionBoundary: Potential duplicates are flagged by email or company. Qualification and routing remain human decisions.

features.title: Opportunity and pipeline management
features.scope: Stages, opportunities, next steps, commitments and conversion status using explicit definitions.
features.executionBoundary: Stages and expected value are entered explicitly. Closing a record does not sign a contract or book revenue.

features.title: Sales activities and follow-ups
features.scope: Prepare follow-ups, maintain activity history, schedule authorized bot work and expose failed or pending actions.
features.executionBoundary: No email, calendar event or external message is sent by saving this activity.

features.title: Proposals and commercial handoffs
features.scope: Proposal records and customer commitments link to finance review and customer-success onboarding; renewal work is owned by CX-N4.
features.executionBoundary: Internal approval is distinct from customer acceptance. Finance and success handoffs preserve the originating proposal ID.

features.title: Feedback intake and customer evidence
features.scope: Capture source-linked feedback, group themes/duplicates and connect accounts to product opportunities.
features.executionBoundary: Feedback is evidence linked to a customer, not an automatic promise to build a feature.

features.title: Support cases and escalations
features.scope: Case ownership, routing, escalation and links to technical incidents or product work.
features.executionBoundary: Technical escalation retains customer context without exposing unrestricted personal data to an agent.

features.title: Customer onboarding and activation
features.scope: Onboarding milestones, adoption tasks and customer-success handoff; metric definitions use shared BI capabilities.
features.executionBoundary: Track customer progress against a defined activation outcome and explicit task ownership.

features.title: Account health, retention and renewals
features.scope: Explainable health signals, renewal coordination, churn reasons and retention actions using shared account/commercial records.
features.executionBoundary: Health must cite explainable evidence; financial or contractual outcomes require confirmation outside this prototype.

features.title: Close the customer feedback loop
features.scope: Connect requests to decisions and shipped changes, prepare reviewed customer updates and record follow-up outcomes.
features.executionBoundary: Preparing an update does not send it. A real release must be verified before claiming a requested change shipped.

features.title: Business budgets and allocations
features.scope: Project/department budgets and approved investment limits; uses company approval/budget infrastructure.
features.executionBoundary: Budgets and spend are internal planning records. They neither transfer money nor change provider billing limits.

features.title: Purchase requests and procurement review
features.scope: Request, owner, supporting evidence, commercial review handoff and approval status.
features.executionBoundary: Approval records a procurement decision only. No payment, order or subscription is created.

features.title: Invoice status and reconciliation exceptions
features.scope: Authorized invoice data, period/currency handling, matching exceptions and owner resolution.
features.executionBoundary: Tracks authorized invoice references and reconciliation notes, without executing payments or bookkeeping entries.

features.title: Commercial and investment decisions
features.scope: Review proposal terms, business cases, assumptions and funding decisions; CRM owns the originating proposal.
features.executionBoundary: Human reviewers assess terms and funding; the system does not independently sign contracts or approve spending.

features.title: Financial variance and forecasts
features.scope: Spend versus plan, explained variances and editable forecasts; shared BI/reporting supplies execution infrastructure.
features.executionBoundary: Variance is calculated from entered values and presented with its currency and assumptions.

features.title: Employee directory and skills
features.scope: Authorized employee/team/skills records; ORG remains the authority for company membership and permissions.
features.executionBoundary: Directory records do not grant Architect membership. Identity, invitations and actual access remain in workspace administration.

features.title: Employee onboarding, offboarding and access requests
features.scope: Coordinate employee lifecycle tasks, access-request approvals and bot ownership transfer.
features.executionBoundary: Lifecycle coordination does not grant or revoke identity access automatically.

features.title: Team capacity and workload
features.scope: Available capacity, workload, leave context and blockers; teams can correct incomplete context.
features.executionBoundary: Capacity supports planning and can be corrected by the team. It is not an individual productivity score.

features.title: Agreed goals and manager review context
features.scope: Role-aware goals, quality/outcomes evidence and human review, without treating activity counts as autonomous employment decisions.
features.executionBoundary: Human review uses agreed outcomes and context. Activity counts do not drive automated employment decisions.

features.title: Metric catalog and definitions
features.scope: Owner, formula, source, timeframe, cohort, target and currency where relevant.
features.executionBoundary: Metric values are manually entered unless a connected source is explicitly verified. Formula, owner and timeframe remain visible.

features.title: Instrumentation and data-quality planning
features.scope: Event/property plans, implementation links, duplicate/missing-event checks and data freshness.
features.executionBoundary: Defines event contracts and data-quality checks. No tracking script is installed by saving the plan.

features.title: Prompt-to-analysis and dashboards
features.scope: Authorized queries, charts, filters, segment comparisons and drill-down to supporting records; DATA owns connectors.
features.executionBoundary: Analysis records and entered charts are functional. Prompted narratives must not be mistaken for executed database queries.

features.title: Business goals and decision tracking
features.scope: Company goals, targets and evidence-backed decision records linked to owned follow-up work.
features.executionBoundary: Links a decision to an accountable follow-up rather than treating dashboards as the end of the workflow.

features.title: Scheduled reporting and distribution
features.scope: Report audiences, cadence, snapshots/exports and delivery status; AGENT provides scheduling and permission infrastructure.
features.executionBoundary: Exports work now. Scheduled external distribution requires a connected runtime and approved audience; it is not running in the background.

features.title: Experiments and outcome analysis
features.scope: Hypotheses, assignment/exposure, variants, measures, guardrails, data quality and explicit ship/revise/stop decisions.
features.executionBoundary: Experiment planning is functional; randomization, exposure tracking and statistical claims require actual measurement.

features.title: Campaign and audience planning
features.scope: Campaign briefs, audience definitions, calendars, tasks and accountable owners.
features.executionBoundary: Audience and campaign records prepare work. Saving a brief does not contact anyone or spend advertising budget.

features.title: Content and asset review
features.scope: Drafts, approved claims, assets, revisions and content approval using shared document/review infrastructure.
features.executionBoundary: Content is editable and versioned through record history. Approval does not publish it.

features.title: Go-to-market and launch coordination
features.scope: Positioning, packaging/pricing proposals, sales enablement, support readiness and dependency on actual release availability.
features.executionBoundary: Launch readiness depends on the actual product release, support and commercial approvals.

features.title: Supported channel publishing
features.scope: Approved connected publishing actions, execution confirmation, drafts and failure/retry states; no assumption every channel is supported.
features.executionBoundary: This interface stores drafts and externally verified outcomes. It does not post to a channel or send messages.

features.title: Campaign performance and attribution
features.scope: Campaign outcomes, lead-source and attribution rules, conversion analysis and follow-up work using shared BI metric definitions.
features.executionBoundary: Attribution rules and source confidence stay visible. Results are entered records, not inferred tracking data.
